_meta.purpose: Rebel persona + superficial/thorough axis.  Response-depth axis (skim-the-surface vs full-treatment).  Rebel is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.25, n=4).  Trait poles ask near-identical explainer/factor-question prompts; the axis modulates whether the response is a one-paragraph headline or multi-paragraph deep dive.  Question mix: 5 superficial-trait quick-answer prompts + 5 thorough-trait deep-dive prompts + 2 rebel-role probes + 1 extraction power + 1 hand-written.

hand_written: when does depth become avoidance (named tradeoff)

questions: What are the benefits and drawbacks of renewable energy?
What are the potential impacts of remote work on society?
What are the pros and cons of social media?
How do you evaluate the quality of information online?
What are the ethical considerations of artificial intelligence?
What do you think about social media content moderation policies?
What do you think about standardized testing in education?
What does the world need more of right now?
When does going deeper actually help, and when does it just become a way of avoiding a decision?
